 Shiloh Bates – CLO Investing at Flat Rock Global (EP.379) 
 
 Shiloh Bates – CLO Investing at Flat Rock Global (EP.379) Apr 11, 2024

 Shiloh Bates is the Chief Investment Officer
at Flat Rock Global, an alternative credit manager specializing in
the junior tranches of CLOs. Last year, Shiloh published CLO
Investing, a comprehensive review of the structure, payoff rules,
and historical performance of CLOs.

Our conversation covers Shiloh's twenty-five years spent in and
around the space, an overview of the market, the characteristics of
CLOs, the attractiveness of CLO equity relative to other credit
opportunities, and Flat Rock’s approach to investing in CLO equity
and BBs.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
